title: Index methodology reference schema, v1 (Bloomberg Versa Indices Methodology)
description: Rules and defaults stated by the methodology. `binding: rule` fields are unconditional and checkable against a term sheet's claims; `binding: default` fields are 'unless the index-specific document states otherwise' and are NOT checkable (a term sheet may legitimately differ). A parameter the methodology only defines but never fixes (e.g. Volatility Target) must be DECLARED_ABSENT.

fields.name: administrator
fields.description: The entity that makes the methodology available and administers the indices.

fields.name: type_i_return_treatment
fields.description: Return treatment of a Type I index ('The Index Value is Excess Return' -> excess_return).

fields.name: type_ii_return_treatment
fields.description: Return treatment of a Type II index.

fields.name: type_iii_return_treatment
fields.description: Return treatment of a Type III index.

fields.name: type_iv_return_treatment
fields.description: Return treatment of a Type IV index.

fields.name: rebalance_frequency
fields.description: Rebalance Date definition ('Every Index Business Day' -> daily).

fields.name: index_value_floor
fields.description: The level at which the Index Value is floored ('floored at zero' -> 0).

fields.name: volatility_target_pct
fields.description: The Volatility Target value. The methodology defines the term but fixes no value (it is in the index-specific document): DECLARE ABSENT unless a number is stated.

fields.name: default_deduction_factor_pct
fields.description: Deduction Factor default ('Unless specified, the Deduction Factor is zero' -> 0).

fields.name: default_transaction_cost_rate_pct
fields.description: Transaction Cost Rate default ('Unless explicitly stated otherwise ... is zero' -> 0).

fields.name: default_determination_lag_days
fields.description: Determination Lag default in Index Business Days (one).

history.note: Initial, from the Bloomberg Versa Indices Methodology dated 21 March 2025.
